body.x: CHOISTECHNOLOGY (CEO Soonpil Choi) announced that it will participate in CES 2026, to be held in Las Vegas, the United States, from January 6 to 9, as part of the INCHEON-IFEZ Pavilion.

Founded in 2001, CHOISTECHNOLOGY is a specialized company in the Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) field. It holds proprietary technologies and numerous domestic and international patents covering core body temperature algorithms, wearable sensors, and wireless communication.

Its flagship product is the wireless continuous core-body temperature monitoring system, Thermosafer XST600. The device supports use not only in hospital environments such as operating rooms, recovery rooms, and intensive care units, but also in home settings. It features a non-invasive heat-flux measurement method.

Heat flux is a physical quantity that quantitatively expresses the flow of heat through a surface, i.e., the thermal energy transferred per unit area per unit time. Thermosafer XST600 measures this value at the skin and reflects metabolic heat generated within the body and heat exchange via blood flow to estimate core body temperature.

Unlike conventional thermometers that primarily reflect skin temperature, the device analyzes heat flow through the skin to derive values closer to core body temperature. For this reason, it has drawn attention as an alternative for continuous patient temperature tracking in medical settings, demonstrating particular value in environments that require precise temperature control, such as operating rooms, intensive care units, and recovery rooms.

body.cap: Thermosafer XST600 | Image provided by CHOISTECHNOLOGY

body.x: Thermosafer XST600 also adopts Bluetooth-based wireless communication and a design optimized for hospital environments to minimize radio interference between medical devices. It supports integration with patient monitoring systems and hospital information systems, including EMR, enabling real-time data integration. As medical staff can check temperature data within existing workflows without additional procedures, the solution is expected to improve operational efficiency.

The system also features a differentiated structure in terms of hygiene and cost efficiency. By separating the central unit and sensor and using a disposable probe that attaches and detaches magnetically, it supports effective infection control while reducing consumables costs and maintenance burden.

A CHOISTECHNOLOGY official said, “Thermosafer XST600 can be used not only in medical facilities but also as a home medical device for older adults and infants, and it can further expand into areas such as infection control, sports, and clinical research as a platform-type temperature monitoring solution. The completeness and scalability of this structure and technology were recognized with the CES 2026 Innovation Award.”

The official added, “At CES, we plan to widely introduce the application value of Thermosafer XST600 to global visitors to strengthen CHOISTECHNOLOGY’s competitiveness in the worldwide digital healthcare market. Rather than focusing solely on product promotion or sales, we aim to identify reliable domestic and overseas partners to pursue joint development and expansion across diverse industries.”

body.x: Incheon Metropolitan City and the Incheon Free Economic Zone Authority announced that they will establish the INCHEON-IFEZ Pavilion in the LVCC North Hall at CES 2026, showcasing Incheon’s urban vision and innovative technologies as the city evolves from smart city development into the AI era. By linking various exhibition programs—including the 10 companies participating in the INCHEON-IFEZ Pavilion, Eureka Park, global pavilions, and the CES Innovation Award Showcase—the organizations will support the participation of 51 Incheon-based innovative companies at CES. Notably, 14 companies received CES Innovation Awards across 17 categories, marking a record-high achievement and demonstrating the technological competitiveness and global growth potential of Incheon’s innovation companies.
